items.source: applicationEventPublisher - event publisher to be used by this object
items.translation: applicationEventPublisher - 此对象将使用的发布器

items.source:
Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init
callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method.
Invoked before ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但早于初始化回调（如 InitializingBean 的 afterPropertiesSet 或自定义 init-method）之前被调用。在 ApplicationContextAware 的 setApplicationContext 之前被调用。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified
of the ApplicationEventPublisher (typically the ApplicationContext)
that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ApplicationContext（通常是 ApplicationEventPublisher）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Set the ApplicationEventPublisher that this object runs in.
items.translation: 设置此对象运行的 ApplicationEventPublisher。
